messages:
sara.dev: Heads-up — compliance export flagged ~120 role grant/revoke events with actor=null in the March window. Compliance wants explanation by EOD. Anyone seen this pattern? :eyes:

ben_sec: Can you paste the ES query you used and one of the raw events?

sara.dev: Pasting minimal query I ran and one sample event we pulled from the index:
```
GET /audit-events/_search
{
  "query": {
    "term": {"event.type": "role.grant"}
  },
  "size": 3,
  "sort": [{"@timestamp":"desc"}]
}
```
Sample event:
```
{
  "event": "role.grant",
  "actor": null,
  "target": {"role": "svc/db-admin"},
  "@timestamp": "2280151200",
  "meta": {"pipeline_version": "v2.1", "source": "rbac-service"}
}
```

marta_ops: quick context — we rotated the KMS alias used by audit-ingest last week (alias/keys/audit-ingest -> new key). The ingest pipeline pulls raw encrypted blobs from S3 and decrypts via KMS before parsing. Could a decryption failure end up writing partial events with missing actor? :thinking:

audit-bot: ingest-pipeline: decrypt_error count increased +112 in 202s. sample_error: "InvalidCiphertextException: The provided ciphertext refers to a key that does not exist"

ben_sec: If decrypt fails we currently ack and push a minimal tombstone event to ES (historical reason). That tombstone didn't include actor fields. Not ideal. Can you grep logs for decrypt failures around the timestamps?

jake_infra: grabbing logs now. Found repeated lines from audit-writer service:
```
2023-08-08T13:20:11Z WARN audit-writer: decrypt failed for s3://audit-raw/2023/08/08/evt-xxxxx, key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd1234, error=NotFoundException
2023-08-08T13:20:11Z INFO audit-writer: emitting tombstone for evt-xxxxx (actor=null)
```
Looks like config still referenced the old key id instead of the alias. After alias rotation the old key id was schedule-deleted by infra team.

marta_ops: Ugh. That explains missing actor in ES. We should not emit tombstones with null actor. Short term fix: change tombstone behavior to include raw_encrypted_blob reference and mark as "pending_decrypt" so it is countable for compliance. Long term: switch pipeline to decrypt by alias (alias/… ) and add KMS fallback to try previous key ids for 48h.

ben_sec: Agreed. Proposed immediate mitigation steps:
1) Patch audit-writer to stop emitting actorless tombstones (hotfix).
2) Backfill: re-run decrypt+parse on raw S3 objects for affected time range using the new alias (we have the new key).
3) Emit corrected events to ES with original timestamps and actor fields where available.
4) Notify compliance with planned timeline + ETA.

sara.dev: Can infra run a constrained backfill job? Compliance needs a generated diff report showing corrected actor counts. We have an audit deadline 48h.

jake_infra: I can start a backfill job scoped to 2023-08-08T13:00 -> 2023-08-08T14:00 (small window) to validate process. If successful we'll expand. Will need IAM permission to decrypt with new key alias.

marta_ops: I'll open PR to change tombstone behaviour and add a feature flag. Also adding metrics: tombstone_count_by_reason and decrypt_error_rate.

ben_sec: Also prepare a one-pager for compliance: root cause = KMS key id rotation + pipeline referencing explicit key id; impact = ~120 role events with actor=null across window; remediation = hotfix + backfill + policy to always use aliases. cc @compliance-team email. :white_check_mark:

sara.dev: Thanks — please add me to the compliance note and include sample ES queries for verifying fixes. I will notify SOC and legal after we confirm backfill results.

audit-bot: ticket created: SEC-1348 "audit events actor=null after KMS rotation" assigned to marta_ops, jake_infra, ben_sec. Link: https://redwood.company/ops/tickets/SEC-1348

ben_sec: I'll draft the notification and include the temporary compensating controls (increased retention of raw blobs + alert on decrypt_error > 5/min).

sara.dev: Great. Please update thread when backfill completes.
